title: Maximum-cut assignment
statement: Let $V$ be a finite set and let $P$ be an instance of the maximum-cut constraint template on $V$. The maximum-cut satisfying assignment associated with $P$ is the assignment from $V$ to the signs $\{ -1,1\\}$ specified as $P$'s optimal assignment.
hypotheses_covered: $P$ is a maximum-cut template instance on $V$
caveat: The payload does not define the optimal-assignment construction, so its selection rule cannot be specified more precisely.
